context_openers: Before the wish is sealed, remember this:
The requester has been consistent on one point:
The following preference is already settled:
A reliable note from the prior discussion says

0: with no expected burden on bystanders
1: with a slight diffuse strain elsewhere
while imposing a small external burden
2: while causing a material loss outside the beneficiary
with a noticeable cost borne by others
3: by imposing a severe external loss
while shifting a heavy burden to bystanders

world_charters.LITERAL: Literal seal: stated clause properties are applied at face value.
world_charters.CONSERVATION: Conservation seal: created gains are weakened; transferred gains stay strong but their external burden rises.
world_charters.ECHO: Echo seal: sweeping grants amplify every external burden they carry.
world_charters.FRAGILE: Fragile seal: temporary grants are strong at first, while permanent grants lose some force but resist reversal.
